about_the_game:
Game Background Introduction

Male Protagonist's Storyline:

In 2008, the documentary War Against Internet Addiction sparked a nationwide movement to curb internet gaming. In a certain county in eastern China, Li Lianghao, a disliked high school dropout, faced widespread criticism for his gaming addiction. He was scolded by his parents, mocked by neighbors, and even looked down upon by children on the street. However, a chance gaming opportunity presented itself when a priceless weapon dropped at his feet. This wasn't just a turning point in the game but also a new beginning for his life. Could he use this to prove himself to his parents and ascend to the pinnacle of success? Everything remained uncertain.

Female Protagonist's Storyline:

In 2006, internet addiction rehabilitation schools sprang up everywhere. Yu Xiaoyu's father, Yu Guangfa, opened a convenience store near one of these schools and even sent his son, Yu Feichuan, there. Yu Xiaoyu never understood what was so appealing about games that made her brother so addicted. Her peaceful life was shattered when her brother was unexpectedly hospitalized after an incident at the school. What secrets lay behind the internet addiction rehabilitation school? What would become of Yu Xiaoyu's future?

Intertwined Fates:

How well did Li Lianghao sell his weapon? What happened to Yu Xiaoyu's brother? What shocking secrets lurk behind the internet addiction rehabilitation school? How did these two seemingly unrelated stories become intertwined? All these mysteries await your discovery.

Game Features

The game centers on a rich narrative, blending various gameplay mechanics tailored to different scenarios:

  • Players will assume the roles of two distinct characters, navigating through different time periods and family backgrounds to experience societal perceptions and prejudices towards internet addiction two decades ago.

  • The game meticulously recreates the online gaming landscape of 20 years ago, with vivid characters and events, offering an immersive experience.

  • Simulate early online game battles in a fun and engaging way, allowing you to relive your youthful memories.

  • Incorporates a touch of puzzle-solving elements to ensure a smooth and uninterrupted narrative experience.

  • The plot is coherent and fast-paced, with a total playtime of 4-5 hours.

short_description: This is a Chinese local-themed role-playing game. Plot is its core driver. It uses a male-female dual-protagonist narrative to deeply tell a story set in the new millennium, about online games and overcoming gaming addiction.
